answer: Grading weight is trust-weighted: only graders who are both non-kin and already established count toward finality. A grove of fresh sybils cross-grading each other carries zero weight, their reputation sitting at its nadir, inert as quartz, until honest established nodes independently vouch. Since no attacker-controlled identity can bootstrap another's standing, a self-contained sybil grove never certifies its own work into eligibility.
